title: Normalized coefficient-linear tower Chern data
statement: For a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a scheme $T$, use Kummer and forgetful data [def-sp-tower-class-systems], normalized derived reduction [def-sp-tower-class-reduction], the canonical $R_\bullet\to A_\bullet$ [def-sp-tower-class-coefficients] and Tate lines [sk-def-sp-tate-twist]. Define Chern data to consist of Kummer data, reduction to $R_\bullet$, a root module with its underlying roots-tower identification, comparisons of the reduced integral unit with $R_\bullet$ and of the reduced units shifted by one with that root module shifted by two, the published K-flat scalar-extension model along $R_\bullet\to A_\bullet$, and its coefficient-unit comparison. Normalized means that the source, positive Kummer-boundary target, and scalar-unit comparisons satisfy the three derived-adjunction equalities of those definitions. Define $c_1^R(L)$ by applying this reduction to the actual integral line-bundle arrow, using its unit and root comparisons. Define the positive line as ordinary scalar extension of the root module in degree zero, its negative as internal Hom into the coefficient unit, and $c_1(L)$ by scalar extension of $c_1^R(L)$ followed by the universal derived-to-ordinary target comparison. These are definitions of the normalized construction, without asserting its existence.
